---- Applicant
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh
Through The Police Station Kotwali, District :

Surguja (Ambikapur), Chhattisgarh
 ---- Respondent
For Applicant : Mr. Raza Ali, Advocate.

For Respondent/State : Mr. Adil Minaj, G.A.
Hon'ble Shri Justice Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal Order on Board 19/09/2023
1.

The accused/applicants has moved this first bail application under Section 439 of Criminal
Procedure Code for releasing him on regular bail during trial in connection with Crime No.
162/2022 registered at Police Station - Kotwali, Ambikapur District Surguja (C.G.) for the offence
punishable under Section 420 of Ipc & 66D It Act.

2.  It is the case of the prosecution that complainant's credit card was hacked by unknown person and the unknown person has withdrawn an amount of Rs. 98,972.64/- and on the basis of this, FIR has been registered against the unknown person.

During investigation of prosecution authority, the applicant was arrested on 20.04.2023.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.

He submits that there is no past antecedent of the applicant, the applicant is not a main accused, the alleged amount that has only been transferred in the account of the main accused and only on the basis of memorandum statement of main accused, the present applicant got implicated.
He further submits that as the applicant is in custody since 20.04.2023 and the trial is likely to take some time for its final disposal, he may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, counsel for the State opposes the bail application.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and also considering the facts that the applicant has no past antecedent, there is no money received by the present applicant and only on the basis of memorandum statement of the main accused, the present applicant got implicated and

also considering the fact that the applicant is in custody since 20.04.2023 and conclusion of the trial may take some more time, I am of the opinion that present is the fit case, in which, the applicant should be enlarged on regular bail.
7. Accordingly, the application for grant of bail is allowed.

Accused/ applicant is directed to be released on bail on his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one local surety (within the State of Chhattisgarh) in the like sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

The applicant is directed to appear before the trial Court on each and every date to be given to him by the said Court till disposal of the trial Sd/-
